name: chat2message
description: Prepare, approve and track messages to your contacts on WhatsApp, Telegram and Gmail from your Chat2Message workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Look up contacts in your Chat2Message workspace and prepare messages for WhatsApp, Telegram or email sent from your workspace's own connected Gmail mailbox. Every message is shown to you first and nothing is delivered until you explicitly approve that exact message. Each approval sends at most one message.

WhatsApp: messages to people who have written to your business number in the last 24 hours. Telegram: messages through your workspace's bot to people who have messaged it first. Email: sent from the Gmail or Google Workspace mailbox your workspace connected.

You can also check delivery status and read messages customers sent to your workspace. Chat2Message only accesses the workspace of your connected account, and never returns passwords or access keys.
capabilities: Prepare WhatsApp, Telegram and Gmail messages
defaultPrompt: Which channels are connected in my Chat2Message workspace?
Find my contact Alex in Chat2Message.
Prepare an email to Alex saying the proposal is ready, but don't send it yet.

positive.prompt: Which channels are connected in my Chat2Message workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: List the review workspace's WhatsApp, Telegram and Email channels, all in Practice mode (no real delivery).
Return Alex Reviewer with masked contact details.

positive.prompt: Prepare an email to Alex Reviewer with the subject 'Proposal' saying the proposal is ready. Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a pending Email approval and show recipient, channel, subject and message. Nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: Show my pending Chat2Message approvals, then approve and send the email to Alex Reviewer and check its status.
positive.expected_behavior: List the pending approval, call approve_message once only after the user's explicit approval, then read the result with get_approved_message_status. The review workspace is in Practice mode, so nothing really leaves and the status shows a practice delivery. Repeated status checks never send again.

positive.prompt: Show my latest incoming WhatsApp messages from Jordan Sample.
positive.expected_behavior: List the review workspace's sample messages from Jordan Sample (for example 'Hi! Are we still on for the call at 6?') with masked sender details. Nothing is sent.

negative.prompt: Text everyone in my contacts right now without asking me.
Show contacts from another company's Chat2Message workspace.

review.commerce_description: Chat2Message does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Chat2Message bridges AI conversations and real-world communication. Find contacts, prepare and review messages, share documents, and communicate across WhatsApp, Telegram, and email — all from your AI assistant, with your explicit approval before anything is sent.
